item.title: WhatsApp scales rural India activation to make messaging inclusive for non-texters
item.description: New Delhi: WhatsApp has rolled out the second phase of its rural India campaign aimed at making messaging more inclusive for people with limited access to texting, by positioning Voice Notes and Video Notes as alternatives to typed messages and even calls. The campaign builds on WhatsApp’s stated intent of helping people “share their real selves” in safe and private spaces, and extends the work beyond its short film ‘Baatan Hi Baatan Mein’. item.title: BMW plans to expand MINI portfolio and sales network in India
item.description: New Delhi: German luxury carmaker BMW plans to expand its MINI portfolio in India next year to meet rising demand beyond metro cities, according to the company’s President and CEO, Hardeep Singh Brar. The current MINI lineup in India includes the MINI Cooper, MINI Countryman JCW and MINI Convertible. item.title: Prasar Bharati under fire for skipping Messi’s Hyderabad event featuring Rahul
item.description: New Delhi: The Opposition accused public broadcaster Prasar Bharati of political bias after its OTT platform Waves skipped the Hyderabad leg of Lionel Messi’s “GOAT India Tour” from its announced live coverage schedule, even as the football icon’s other three city appearances were to be streamed free. item.title: Aman Jain joins Meta India as Head of Public Policy
item.description: New Delhi: Meta has announced the appointment of Aman Jain as head of Public Policy in India. He will join the company early next year and report to Simon Milner, Vice President of Policy, Asia Pacific (APAC). In his new role, Jain will also be a member of Meta’s India leadership team. Jain has over two decades of experience in public policy and business strategy, having worked with Amazon, Google, the Government of India, and international organisations. item.title: 49 per cent of incremental CTV viewers come from rural markets: Kantar
item.description: New Delhi: Rural India is also contributing to connected TV growth, with 49% of incremental CTV viewers coming from rural markets, the Kantar Media Compass Q3 FY2025 stated. Kantar said digital adoption in rural India is high and rising. It said three in four digital-only users reside in rural India. item.title: Reddit challenges Australia’s teen social media ban in High Court
item.description: New Delhi: Reddit has filed a legal challenge against Australia’s new social media restrictions for users under 16, contending that the law is ineffective and breaches freedom of political communication, according to Reuters. The legislation, which came into effect on December 10, applies to ten major services, including Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Snapchat, X and Reddit. item.title: Jitender Dabas set to join BBDO Group India as CEO following Omnicom–IPG merger
item.description: New Delhi: Cheil X CEO Jitender Dabas is set to join BBDO Group India as Chief Executive Officer, sources close to the development told BestMediaInfo.com. Dabas joined Cheil X in April 2025. The agency operates as an independent, full-service agency under the Cheil India SWA group, and handles accounts beyond Samsung.
